## Shared Layer Contract

| Module | Responsibility | Key API |
|---|---|---|
| `InputManager` | Polls keyboard + gamepad, normalizes to `Vector2` + button map | `getAxis()`, `getButton()`, `wasJustPressed()` |
| `ObjectPool` | Pre-allocates N objects, hands out / recycles via callbacks | `acquire()`, `release()`, `reset()` |
| `ParticleManager` | Owns all particle pools, enforces 500 cap, routes to presets | `burst()`, `spark()`, `explosion()`, `update(dt)` |
| `CameraShake` | Accumulates trauma, decays per-frame, applies to camera offset | `addTrauma(amount)`, `update(dt, camera)` |
| `HitStop` | Freezes `dt` for N frames, stacks on heavy hits | `trigger(duration)`, `getTimescale()` |
| `MotionTrails` | Attaches trail renderers to fast-moving meshes | `attach(mesh, length, color)`, `update(dt)` |
| `ShockwaveRings` | Spawns expanding torus rings that fade and self-dispose | `emit(position, maxRadius, color)` |
| `FloatingText` | Spawns 3D text sprites + HTML overlay, auto-removes | `show(position, text, color)` |
| `AudioManager` | Web Audio oscillators + noise buffers, no external files | `playSFX(type)`, `startMusic()`, `stopMusic()` |
| `EffectComposerSetup` | Creates composer with bloom, returns configured instance | `create(renderer, width, height)` |
| `ProceduralTextures` | Canvas-drawn textures (grids, gradients, noise, scanlines) | `createGridTexture()`, `createNoiseTexture()`, etc.` |
| `SimplexNoise` | Deterministic noise for geometry displacement | `noise2D(x,y)`, `noise3D(x,y,z)` |
| `MemoryTracker` | Tracks all allocations, batch-disposes on game teardown | `track()`, `disposeAll()` |

## Vite Configuration Strategy

- `vite.config.js` resolves bare imports via alias: `shared` → `./shared/`
- ES modules throughout, no transpilation needed
- Dev server on port 5173, HMR for rapid iteration

---

## Compliance Statements

**Anti-Lazy Directive:** Every function body will be fully implemented. No `// ... rest of logic`, no `// TODO`, no stubs. If a file is too long for one response, I will stop cleanly and resume on "continue" from the exact truncation point.

**Strict Memory Management:** Every `Geometry`, `Material`, and `Texture` created procedurally is tracked via `MemoryTracker`. Game teardown calls `disposeAll()`. Object pools prevent GC churn. `InstancedMesh` used for repeated geometry (particles, projectiles, collectibles).

**Sequential Output Protocol:** I will not generate code for any game you have not named. The `shared/` layer is written once and reused. Each game is planned → approved → implemented in full before moving on.

---

**Which game are we building first?** Name it and I'll produce the exhaustive `plan.md`.
